title: Implement --dry-run flag: preview without writing files
description: When --dry-run is passed, run the full clarification + spec generation + preview flow, but skip the file-write step when the user selects 'Yes'. Print a dry-run mode indicator.
acceptanceCriteria: Dry-run message is printed indicating no files were changed
Neither PRD.md nor tasks.json is modified after a dry-run

steps.description: Pass dryRun flag through to the apply step
steps.details: In featureCommand, extract options.dryRun. Pass it to the confirmation handler so the apply step knows not to write files.

steps.description: Skip file writes when dryRun is true
steps.details: In the onApply callback: if (options.dryRun) { console.log('\n[Dry run] No files were changed.'); return }. Otherwise: await writeFeatureSpec(...); await mergeTasks(...)

steps.description: Add dry-run indicator to the preview
steps.details: Show a yellow banner in FeatureDiffPreview when dryRun is true: <Text color='yellow'>⚠ DRY RUN — changes will not be applied</Text>
